about: The bootstrap manifest: every frozen runtime module, in git until Docs run, when it becomes a typed Doc of Aven's vault and each module a blob (README, "Only from the repository"; ARCHITECTURE A45): append-only. An entry is a module frozen, {name, version, hash, limits, users}, or a frozen module withdrawn, {"withdrawn": hash}; there are no floors. A module is loaded only by a hash listed here and not withdrawn after, and only when its bytes have that hash. `sh freeze.sh --check`, in the box, rebuilds each module and fails when its bytes aren't the frozen hash: a change to a runtime is its next version, appended.
